name: read_flow
title: Read a flow
description:
One flow: settings, persona, triggers, and every card with its settings and where each outcome leads (`next`:
a card id, "stop" or "flow:<id>").  Trust `next`: outcomes can depend on settings. `complete: false` means the flow did not fit or you
asked for less: every card and wire is there, but not all settings, which `card_ids` reads. A value shown as
{"redacted": true, ...} is a recipient list, calendar, routing key or pasted sample, summarised on purpose.

detail.description: `outline` leaves out card settings and persona text.

card_ids.description: Only these cards keep their settings.

include_variables.description: Also list the `{{ path }}` variables a card can use. `render_only` paths cannot be branched on.
